caption: The drawing consists of a grid with six rectangular panels arranged in three rows and two columns, each containing stencil-like images rendered in white against a textured, dark background. In the upper left panel, there is a large ram-like animal with prominent curved horns, accompanied by angular abstract shapes above and a geometric figure beside it. The upper right panel features two ram-like animals, a small humanoid figure, and a roughly rectangular shape resembling a log or a tree stump. The middle left panel depicts a large animal with curling horns, decorated body, and a smaller animal beneath it. The middle right panel contains a stylized humanoid form standing and several zigzag lines, with smaller human figures and abstract shapes. The lower left panel shows a series of interconnected geometric shapes and zigzag lines, some resembling animals with horns. The lower right panel displays two horned animals standing and one resting on the ground. The entire composition uses only two colors: an off-white for the figures and a dark gray or black for the background.
title: Petroglyph
